تهادرت (form VI)
# تَهَادَرْتُ (tahādartu) /ta.haː.dar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# تَهَادَرْتَ (tahādarta) /ta.haː.dar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# تَهَادَرْتِ (tahādarti) /ta.haː.dar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# تَهَادَرَتْ (tahādarat) /ta.haː.da.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
